# web_research_tool

> Web research tool for researcher agents.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `research` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=web_research_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Web research tool for researcher agents. Three modes:

- mode: "search"     — return a ranked list of search results for `query`.
                       Each result has {title, url, snippet}.
- mode: "fetch"      — fetch a single URL and return cleaned visible text.
                       Strips HTML/scripts/styles. Truncates very long pages.
- mode: "summarize"  — search + fetch top N results in one call. Returns
                       a bundle: {results: [...], pages: [{url, title, text}]}.
                       Use for "give me everything about X" in one shot.
- mode: "wikipedia"  — query Wikipedia directly via its public API. Returns
                       intro extract + key sections. Good for grounding /
                       definition lookups.

No API key is required for the default backend (DuckDuckGo HTML). If the
tenant has set tavily_api_key or brave_api_key on its default LlmModel's
custom_fields, those higher-quality backends are used automatically.

Cite every URL you use — the tool returns the URL with every result so you
can include it in your Sources section.

EXAMPLES:

Quick search:
  {mode: "search", query: "kubernetes operator pattern best practices"}

Fetch one URL:
  {mode: "fetch", url: "https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/operator/"}

One-shot bundle (search + fetch top 3):
  {mode: "summarize", query: "competitor pricing for project management SaaS 2026", top_n: 3}

Wikipedia:
  {mode: "wikipedia", query: "Hashicorp Vault"}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | yes | search \| fetch \| summarize \| wikipedia. One of: `search`, `fetch`, `summarize`, `wikipedia`. |
| `query` | string | no | Search query (required for search/summarize/wikipedia modes) |
| `url` | string | no | URL to fetch (required for fetch mode) |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Max search results to return (default 10, max 25) |
| `top_n` | integer | no | For summarize mode, how many top results to fetch (default 3, max 10) |
| `max_chars_per_page` | integer | no | Truncate each fetched page to this many chars (default 8000, max 25000) |

## Example

```json
{"name": "web_research_tool", "arguments": {"mode": "search", "query": "Context7 add library GitLab", "max_results": 5}}
```

```json
{"name": "web_research_tool", "arguments": {"mode": "fetch", "url": "https://context7.com/docs/adding-libraries", "max_chars_per_page": 8000}}
```

## Gotchas

- **`mode` decides the required field:** `query` for `search`, `summarize` and `wikipedia`;
  `url` for `fetch`.
- **Pages are truncated** at `max_chars_per_page` (default 8000); raise it deliberately, not by default.
